Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu!! Respected pious scholar,there is a website named facebook & It has started an application named electronic quran in which their are 60 reciters & u have to select 1 recitor and select surah then listen . My purpose to listen is to make my QURAN recitation best.How do I know who is the best recitor?? should I use it?should I concentrate on the scholar who is teaching me. JAZAKALLAH. Answer ID: 27295 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1808/1430/D=1431) You should maintain full respect and etiquette at the time of listening to the holy Quran and listen to it with concentration. There is no harm in it, but it should not be for entertainment. Only by listening to the Qirah, one cannot improve himself rather it is improved by studying before any teacher and by practicing before any good Qari. Hence, you should learn correct pronunciation and makharij (outlet of letter sound) from any scholar, it is enough and if he is Qari, you should practice Qirah before him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
